text:
Ivar Stenberg is 19, three weeks into his NHL career, and the Sharks are already treating him like a top-line forward. Sharks Hockey Digest had him skating with Macklin Celebrini at practice this week, and in Pittsburgh on Nov. 11 he played 22:43. Two nights before that he won an eight-round shootout against the Islanders. The Hockey Writers called him the one thing going right in San Jose, which says plenty about both.

The scoring is right on schedule: 12 points in 21 games, 0.57 a game, almost exactly the median first season for forwards picked in the top four since 2005. His six goals match his 6.0 expected goals (the quality of his chances), and San Jose Hockey Now reported he hit three posts in one game this week, so there was more available.

The hard part is five on five, where the Sharks have had only 41% of the expected goals with him on the ice. That's mostly the team around him, for now. Watch what happens to that number next to Celebrini.
headline: Stenberg, hitting posts on the top line
